title: review follow-ups of PR #36325
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5miLqNucRZevceHwNh

Filing gate ① (follow-ups of one PR) · Source: fleet · residuals of PR #36325 (card #35609), from its os-dev report 7075209014 (out_of_scope_findings).

## Items
- [ ] Doc drift: `ObjectQLPlugin.refreshReloadedPackages`' docblock (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`) still says items removed from the artifact stay registered until restart. Stale since #33050 for package-body items, and after #36325 for object extensions too. Done when the docblock says what a reload withdraws now (package-body items and extension layers) and what it still keeps until restart (owned objects, per `ingestReloadedObjects`' own docblock).
- [ ] Inferred, not exercised: a withdrawal of an extension layer (the #36325 re-register path, an uninstall, an `object_extension` item delete) is not asked the ADR-0144 run-end record-currency follow door, which judges registered layers only. If another package's amount field follows a currency-code field that the withdrawn layer brought, the pair is left unjudged. Done when this is measured (withdraw such a layer, read what the follow door and the served amount answer) and either judged at withdrawal like at registration, or recorded as not reachable.

reach: item 1 is shipped source text only; item 2 read from code (`withdrawObjectExtension` and the ADR-0144 run-end door), not measured.
Business reason: item 1 misleads the next developer about reload; item 2 could leave an amount following a currency field that no longer exists, with no refusal.
Reader: a domain:server lane (objectql registry).
Dedupe: `refreshReloadedPackages` → 1 open hit (#35609, the card this PR fixes); `withdrawal currency follow` → 3 open hits (#35609 and two seat posts, none on this mechanism).
Grade: p3 · area:package · Bug · doc drift and an inferred, unmeasured gap · reach read · evidence read.
